يكتنزون (form VIII)
# يَكْتَنِزُونَ (yaktanizūna) /jak.ta.ni.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
# يُكْتَنَزُونَ (yuktanazūna) /juk.ta.na.zuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِكْتَنَزَ (iktanaza)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
